description_en: Delete a share authorization for a data work
description_zh: 删除数据作品的一个分享授权
name: CancelReportShare

parameters.help_en: The ID of the work. The works here include BI portal, dashboards, spreadsheets, and self-service access
parameters.help_zh: 作品的ID。这里的作品包括数据门户，仪表板，电子表格，自助取数
parameters.name: report_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the person to be shared, which may be the user ID of the Quick BI or the user group ID.

If ShareToType is 0 (user), ShareTo is the user ID.
When ShareToType is set to 1 (user group), ShareTo is the user group ID.
When ShareToType=2 (organization), ShareTo is the ID of the organization
parameters.help_zh:
被分享者的ID，可能是Quick BI的用户ID，也可能是用户组ID。

ShareToType=0（用户）时，ShareTo为用户ID。
ShareToType=1（用户组）时，ShareTo为用户组ID。
ShareToType=2（组织）时，ShareTo为组织ID
parameters.name: share_to_ids

parameters.help_en:
The deletion method. Valid values:

0: Delete by user
1: Delete by user group
2: Delete by organization
parameters.help_zh:
删除方式。取值范围：

0：按用户删除
1：按用户组删除
2：按组织删除
parameters.name: share_to_type
